en: None taken.
Urgh! My back!

Ah, threw out your back, did ya? That's what ya get for
over-exertin' yourself, old-timer.
Yes, but, my, aren't you one to talk?

Your dancin's strictly amateur hour, too. Honestly felt like
I was pickin' on ya.
But a bet's a bet. I'll be takin' that 1,000 yen.
You lost <Color:8>1,000 yen<Color:Default>.

Now you take care of yourself. If you're lookin' for a
rematch, I'm always willing. You know where to find me.

Hm? What's up? Decide you're up for that dance battle? Gotta
throw in your 1,000 yen first, though.
Hm? You a dancer, too? Kind of old for that, ain't ya?
Haha, you're telling me?

Not a bad face, though. You remind me of my husband when he
was a lot younger.

So, what can I do for ya? Wanna square off in a dance
battle? The bet's just 1,000 yen.

Uh, are you sure you're going to be all right? Dancing's
pretty strenuous, don't you think?

Pshaw, that ain't nothin' for you to concern yourself with.
I was a prima ballerina with a company in Europe when I was
younger.
Don't assume I'm just some run-of-the-mill granny.

Wow. You're a former prima ballerina? That's, uh... Time
sure can be cruel, huh?

Heh, a joker, are ya? I like you. C'mon, join me for a dance
battle.

(A dance battle, huh? Well, I have seen Haruka dance, so I
suppose I might be able to hold my own.)
No thanks, I'll pass.
And leave me hangin'? That's weak!
Hey, what was that? I just got served by an old lady!

Idiot. I've seen kids dance better than you. Your
fundamentals stink.

You call yourself a dancer? That's an outright lie. You
oughta be ashamed of yourself.
Okay, sonny, pay up. Come on, 1,000 yen.
Fine! I'll pay, I'll pay!

Hehehe. And that's why I'm not about to give up on dance
battles any time soon. There's more money to be made here
than at the pachinko parlor.

(The old lady put money on that dance battle? Huh, there's
something you don't see every day.)

So, anyone else wanna take me on? Got plenty of dancin' left
in me. Lay down your bets⑬just 1,000 yen for a dance-off
with yours truly!
Hey, you know Nico Nico Seiga? I posted an illustration the other day, and it got a ton of comments. It blew me away, y'know?
Is that so? Congrats. You couldn't get people to notice your work if you paid them before.
No joke. It's amazing, the feedback you can get. They have illustration contests, too. I'm thinking I should give that a try.
Nico Nico Seiga? What the heck's that? You mean Nico Nico Douga?
They're related, but Nico Nico Douga's for videos. Seiga's for sharing stuff like manga and illustrations. It's cool. Check it out.
Hey, hey, didja see last week's Princess League? The dancing for that new song was so cute!
Yeah! Wasn't that dance's choreography video up on Nico Nico Douga? We should practice it, so we can do it, too.
Yeah! Let's practice together. When we master it, we should record ourselves and upload it to Nico Nico Douga.
Oh, you mean the "I tried to dance" videos? It might be a little embarrassin', but it also sounds fun. Let's do it!
These "I tried to dance" videos on Nico Nico Douga are amazing. It's crazy how good some of these folks are, and they're not even pros. Dang!
Toshi, your singing's, like, totally deep and divine. It's a waste to just sing for me, though, y'know? Not that I'm complaining, but, like, everyone should hear you! Definitely!
You think so? Maybe I should try posting a video on Nico Nico Douga, then.
You mean those "I tried to sing" videos? I heard the really popular singers rank right up there with pop stars.
Toshi-kun, I'm tellin' ya, you can't fail. People'll totally love ya. Ya gotta put yourself out there!
Hehehe, my pipes are in especially fine form today. I should post some singing videos on Nico Nico Douga.
Hang on.
...Huh?
I'm Mach-ko. I watched you bowl. You have impressive technique.
So impressive, in fact, that I've decided I'm going to dedicate my bowling career to taking you down! That's right, you and I? We're rivals!
I appreciate the sentiment, but I'm going to have to pass.
Nonsense! We're rivals now! Let's push each other to be better. Here's my phone number. C'mon, take it! There you go.
Give me a ring when you feel like bowling head to head. Oh, also, your friends are my friends, so they can call me, too. See you!
...What was that about?
You can now call up your rival to play competitive bowling.
Hey, big guy.
...You talking to me?
Yeah. The name's Gachita. Seeing you hurl that ball with authority was really something else!
That massive build. Your musky machoness. I swear, just looking at you is making the hairs on my heck stand on end. I have to have you as my rival!
Here's my phone number. Please, take it.
Call me if you ever need a bowling buddy. I'd be more than happy to join you, big guy. See ya!
You can now call up your rival to play competitive bowling. However, you may not do so until you obtain a mobile phone.
Uiro's a Nagoya specialty. What's it made of, though?
A hostess club is where a man's troubles go to die. All aboard! Next stop, the worries graveyard!
Having a crush is so hard. It'd be a lot more efficient for reproduction of the species if I could just get over her and move on.
You think a lot, don't you?
Yes, I'm actually calling from bed at home. Yes, I'm terribly sorry. *cough* Wheeze!
Summer's the best season. The buzzing of cicadas, the beach, the blazing sun... What's not to love!?
How about the fact that summer's just hot, humid, and gross? Winter's the real winner. Nabe stews, hot springs, games with friends while huddled in a kotatsu...
The tree's beautiful, but its beauty is no more than a bauble, unlike your beauty, which...
Enough! Stop! Please! I'm sorry, but I just cannot take any more of this garbage!
I can't get a feel for Nagoya's geography. The city's laid out like a grid without a focal point. Where's our hotel?
Kyoto's like a grid, too! It's so pretty.
Huh? Well, it is, but that isn't helping us find our hotel.
Let's get some PrintCircle photos together. We can make little hearts with our hands.
Eww! Forget PrintCircle, let's play Virtua Fighter! I'll take you on!
Look, look, Yu-kun! There's a sexy shop! Oh my gosh, look! Ooh, sexy!
No, please, don't. People are looking.
Ooh, man, it's freezin'. Doin' the rounds in this cold is tough on the feet. Let's grab a drink before we finish.
Sounds good, boss! One hot shot of sake down the hatch. Boom!
Yeah, not a chance. We got work to do. Don't tell me you actually thought that'd work.
Aww, you got my hopes up, bossman!
Aren't there any women waiting to be found? Of course, they're likely not worth finding.
All hail alcohol! The greatest friend for helping you forget all of life's trials and tribulations! And the worst traitor for the morning hangover!
I got a hot date lined up! She's a hostess, but still. Money can buy you love, you know. That's the lesson of the day.
I didn't eat anything today, so I ordered three meals' worth. I couldn't even finish one. The human body's a mystery. Urp...
I got paid, so I decided to check out a new bar. It turns out it was run by mobsters, and they took it all. How am I going to eat now?
They already identified some dumbass who bragged about a crime online just today. Online sleuths are scary people!
Surely you can manage. I'm done with work for the day, so I'm going home to enjoy my cream puffs from the M Store in peace.
How did I end up in the sexy part of town? Kamurocho is so scary!
Watch a DVD or have a little rub and tug? Hmm... Which will it be tonight?
I had a few drinks and I'm feeling quite happy. My friends were being boring so I ran off on my own.
So... Where am I?
Wasn't there an ice cream shop here? It's turned into a Gindaco. Man, everything's different.
My phone's battery died. It's impossible to meet up with people like this. How did people manage to meet in the old days?
When you hit on chicks, there's a few factors at play: time, place, and luck. Those factors decide whether you succeed or fail.
Today, I had no luck...
I love barbecue with beer. That B-and-B combo is the greatest... But it's so fattening.
Karaoke was fun. We should get going, though.
I'm not done singing! I forgot to sing "So Much More!" Oh, I could go for hours.
I want a girlfriend! Tell me what it takes to get one.
I'd like to know that myself! Not once in my life have I ever gone out with a girl!
You have to get the women to fall for you. Just flatter the hell out of them. It's music to their ears, my friend.
I see. Got it!
Everywhere I go, I see happy couples, and yet I'm by myself. It's not fair! Why do I have to get dumped right before Christmas!?
I'm telling you, you're blowing this out of proportion. I only went to eat with Akemi. There's nothing going on between us!
Look me in the eyes and say that.
There's something going down in Kamurocho. It's going to be big.
You'd better be careful, too.
Here I am in Tokyo's roughest neighborhood, and I get separated from my friends...
I mean, this is the kind of place where thugs fight because they looked at each other wrong.
I keep popping into convenience stores. I don't need anything, but I just do. Am I, like... lonely?
Oh, I love hearing that from you! Let's pop the best champagne you have next time!
You will? Hehe, I love you, baby. Really.
I made some money gambling. It'll be all gone tomorrow, so which basic need do I satisfy? Hunger or lust?
It's an age-old question all men grapple with.
Are you insane? Everyone knows that chikuwa is the best complement for oden. Nothing else comes close.
I'm so sorry, I hear what you're saying but none of it makes any sense. If you don't understand fried rice's role, you have no authority to speak about ramen.
We have to end this. It was never meant to work out. This long-distance romance is so hard.
I'm checking my phone all the time. It's pretty much automatic now.
I can't imagine what I'd do without it. I'd be so scared if I actually lost it.
All I hear these days is how my buddies are all getting married and having kids. Mom and pop stuff, you know?
Don't get me wrong, I'm happy for them and all, but it makes me angsty.
I wish I had a winning lottery ticket. I better buy some first, though, huh?
Uh, one guy, two women... Could you please not talk to me right now?
You won't find me happier than when I'm eating. I don't have a girlfriend, but who cares?
I want my buddy to pay back the money I loaned him, but I don't want to pester him. It's a fair amount of money, though...
I'm going home, crawling under the kotatsu, and TVing out. No one can stop me now.
I got rejected again. It's crushing to get to the third round of interviews only to be cut. What can I do to change this?
Try this: Pretend you really like the interviewers. Like, sincerely. It will make you act naturally bright, cheerful, and earnest.
I don't get it. You're just amazing if you can do that.
Evenings make me sentimental.
Yup, yup. And?
Would you look at me and not your phone when I'm talking?
I hate winter. The air's all dry and dusty, and there's a lot more static electricity.
I'm on edge today. Karaoke's the only cure for these blues and blahs.
What does it take to get better at bowling? Will using different balls make me better?
How could you forget? This is our four-month anniversary since we met!
Sorry, honey. I'll buy you some clothes to make up for it, okay?
Keep your skin properly moisturized, and it will stay looking young. Be especially generous with moisturizing lotion in the winter.
How about going to a hot spring? With all the girls, I mean.
Sounds good. Although⑬and I'm being honest⑬I would rather go with a guy, but we're all solo. We need to refresh and get ourselves some guys.
That's the plan, then! We'll reel 'em in!
What are you, stupid? You're not fooling me with your impersonation scam. Get with the times, you asshole!
I'm meeting a guy on a date. My life's riding on this. I don't have time for you, loser!
I get texts from hook-up sites all the time. Some of them are pretty funny. Like, funny enough to even make me click them. Almost.
It's ingenious, honestly. There's a lot of clever trial-and-error going on.
I want to fix my stooped posture, but it's not so easy to do when it's become such a habit.
